exact_blockers: No exact MS-iSTFT-Generator source is present or pinned. There is no checkout under data/checkouts (ms-istft-generator, MS-iSTFT-Generator, ms_istft_generator), no official repository revision, no LICENSE/notice bundle for that release and no official source digest. The pinned research record names no official repository or immutable revision. A derived Multistream_iSTFT_Generator module is visible at LLVC commit 1627c5d358cf9bb2b92b0ccc513d8b36807c923d (MIT, minimal_quickvc/models.py), but it is not the official MS-iSTFT-Generator release and is not admitted.

No exact weight identity exists. No generator checkpoint, ONNX graph, release tag, byte count, SHA-256 or linked asset-ledger row is recorded. Fixed probes are absent: data/models/ms-istft-generator, data/models/ms-istft-generator/generator.pt, data/models/ms-istft-generator/generator.onnx, data/models/ms_istft_generator, data/models/ms_istft_generator/generator.pt and cpp-library/.deps/ms_istft_generator.onnx. The observed LLVC checkout contains zero weight files, and its full-system LLVC checkpoint was removed after the documented any-to-one run.

No runtime is present or pinned. There is no recorded Python, PyTorch, ONNX Runtime or other host version, wheel digest, target platform, lock file or evaluator environment; data/envs/ms-istft-generator is absent. No exact-runtime reference run, parity vector or isolated vocoder inference was produced.

Rights, permitted scope and consent are unresolved. The rights register has no ms-istft-generator, ms_istft_generator or istft entry, so acquisition, evaluation, redistribution, customer deployment and public playback are all unknown. The containing LLVC code is MIT, but no MS-iSTFT-Generator model card, weight terms or training-data terms exist, and MIT source alone does not clear weights, voice references or outputs. For a voice task, consent for source and target speaker references, reference availability and output use are independent gates and none is recorded.

No candidate geometry is known. No authoritative MS-iSTFT-Generator sample rate, spectral configuration, subband count, iSTFT FFT/hop layout, receptive field, lookahead or streaming state is recorded. Constructor defaults in the observed derived LLVC file are not an authoritative candidate pin, so this package fabricates none and exposes no v0 frame adapter. The surrogate's 80-bin/160-hop/2-frame values are fixture parameters, not candidate geometry.

The pinned research evidence is a negative run record, not candidate evidence. It states the candidate was not run because no compatible accent-converter acoustic model/checkpoint was identified for an end-to-end local run. A multi-stream iSTFT vocoder alone cannot perform an accent conversion, and there is no fixed upstream acoustic model, feature contract or end-to-end accent-conversion pipeline to reproduce.

No candidate evidence exists. There is no output, exact-reference parity, rights-cleared paired voice cohort with permitted references, independent semantic, identity or naturalness scorer, permitted listening result or target-runtime timing. The synthetic feature-frame surrogate is not MS-iSTFT-Generator and cannot qualify the candidate. All eight release gates remain blocked and no result may qualify the candidate.

A caller-supplied-asset reference or opt-in adapter cannot be built or verified, so no processor is exposed and the conditional implementation remains open.
